title: Dereth Town Tour - Plateau Village scratch

shots.standingOrder: Rise up the escarpment face from the ravine floor until 23 m above the plateau rim while easing south toward the village; stay 40 m from the cliff top and trees.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING (drone.rising-reveal). Starts 4 m above the floor of the ravine that cuts north of the village (z 177), facing the 65 m escarpment; rises 86 m while drifting 30 m south until 23 m above the plateau rim, pitching from the rock face to the horizon: the rim houses, the timber roofs of the village, the plateau edge and the long view west appear (the square itself stays behind the first row of houses; s020 shows it). Peak 8.9 m/s. shots.standingOrder: Look straight down on the village square from 48 m rising to 62 m while the image turns slowly clockwise.
shots.notes: LANDMARK / PATTERN (classic.birds-eye). Straight down over the village square at 48 to 62 m (z 288-302), image turning 35 deg: the Town Network portal swirl, the Nullified Statue of a Skeleton on its column plinth (an Anniversary Effect emitter sits on it), the four candelabras and the brown timber roofs of the Aluvian houses on the green plateau. shots.standingOrder: Dolly slowly west along the wedding aisle at eye level toward the altar and the twin pillars; keep at least 5 m from every torch and tree.
shots.notes: FX: FLAMES + LANTERNS (classic.dolly-in). On the plateau's northern promontory (the Plateau Wedding site) the camera dollies 22 m west down the aisle at eye level (z 242 to 245): ten blue-flame torches (0x02000719) line the benches on both sides, two orange-leaved lantern trees each hung with 15 glowing brass lanterns frame the shot, ahead the altar with two standing flame lanterns and flowers and the twin 15.5 m stone pillars capped with green and blue glows, sky and the void beyond. Afternoon sun from the west backlights the altar. shots.standingOrder: Fly level west through the 12 m gap between the twin pillars at 8 m height and on out over the cliff; never descend below z 247 over the altar.
shots.notes: CLOSING / HERO (drone.flythrough). From over the benches the drone flies west at z 248 between the twin wedding pillars (gap 12.2 m, pillars to z 255.6, 6.1 m clearance each side), 4.5 m above the altar lanterns and the officiant, and straight out over the 150 m drop off the plateau into open sky and cloud; cruise 4 m/s slowing to 2.4 m/s at the gap. JEV-hero candidate (a gap move).
